Elsevier (2025-2027)

No publishing costs for Dutch authors in more than 2200 'hybrid' and full open access journals.

License and conditions

  • This agreement is for the period of 2025-2026.
  • The agreement applies to the following types of publications: original articles, review articles.
  • Note: capped deal! The cap for hybrid journals has been reached.
  • In 2024, all participants together are allowed to publish a maximum of 733 articles. In 2025, they are allowed to publish 707 articles, and in 2026, 680.

How does it work?

  • Indicate in the publication stage of your article that your research is to be published open access.

This contract and its duplicate disclose the agreement.
